stories.title: Critical Microsoft Copilot CoSnitch Vulnerability Lets Attackers Steal Sensitive Data With One Click
stories.description: A critical vulnerability in Microsoft Copilot Personal, tracked as CVE-2026-24301 and nicknamed CoSnitch, lets attackers silently siphon sensitive data from a victim's connected accounts with nothing more than a single click on a malicious link.

stories.title: Microsoft Copilot Personal Flaws Could Let One Click Exfiltrate Data From Connected Apps
stories.description: CVE-2026-24301 lets crafted Copilot Personal links auto-run prompts that can pull data from connected apps and exfiltrate it via URL fetches.

stories.title: Attackers Exploit MLflow SSRF Flaw to Steal Cloud Credentials and Secrets
stories.description: Attackers exploit MLflow CVE-2026-64849 via SSRF to steal cloud credentials, while FUXA CVE-2026-25895 draws malicious scanning.

stories.title: French Tax Authority Data Breach Exposes 600,000+ Users’ Personal Tax-Related Data
stories.description: France’s tax authority confirmed a breach affecting 678,000 individuals and businesses after attackers compromised employee and third-party credentials.

stories.title: Ransom Busters Claims It Hacked Ransomware Servers, Asks Victims for Up to $60,000
stories.description: Ransom Busters claims ransomware server access and asks victims for $20,000 to $60,000 to recover files and delete stolen data.
